label: For "Loan Hardship Case Triage": Route incoming hardship requests to the right treatment and priority, quickly and fairly, while spotting customers in vulnerable circumstances. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Offline labels come from past routing, which carries its own bias.
